description: This file defines Express.js route handlers for authentication-related endpoints, including a health check for auth configuration and a placeholder login API. It sets up routing logic, input validation, and environment configuration checks.

methods.name: router.get('/health')
methods.description: Handles GET requests to /api/auth/health, returning status of tenant salt configuration.

methods.name: router.post('/login')
methods.description: Handles POST requests to /api/auth/login, validating user input, checking environment configuration, resolving tenant, and returning placeholder auth response.
